name: Madagascar Plover
rangeDescription: Coastal southwestern madagascar
description: Small plover with a brown back, pale underparts, and a black chest band. Distinctive head pattern, with one black stripe behind the eye and another across the forehead.

name: Chestnut-throated Monal-Partridge
rangeDescription: Alpine mountain slopes of northeastern tibet
description: Large modestly-colored terrestrial bird of open woodlands, scrublands, and meadows in alpine areas. Brown overall with a peaked head, chestnut throat, and bright red skin around the eye.

name: Marañon Spinetail
rangeDescription: Southern ecuador (zamora-chinchipe) to northwestern peru (northern cajamarca)
description: Very shy spinetail restricted to the Marañon Valley of northwestern Peru and extreme southern Ecuador; highly threatened due to ongoing habitat loss. Plumage is mostly gray with chestnut back, wings, and tail.

name: Pied-winged Swallow
rangeDescription: Savanna of western africa (senegambia to far western cameroon)
description: A small martin-like swallow with pale underparts, steel-blue upperparts, and distinctive white patches in the wings. Female has a shorter tail than the male.

name: Dinelli's Doradito
rangeDescription: Locally in northern argentina; winters to southern bolivia, western paraguay, and southwestern brazil
description: Small yellowish flycatcher of marshlands in central and northern Argentina, moving north during the nonbreeding season. Similar to Subtropical, Warbling, and Ticking Doraditos, from which it is most easily identified by voice, but note brownish cap and brownish (as opposed to olive or gray) auriculars.

name: Red-backed Sierra Finch
rangeDescription: Andes of southwestern bolivia to northern chile and northwestern argentina
description: Handsome “finch” that is actually a tanager; found very locally on bogs and rocky slopes of the high Andes. Usually in pairs (sexes look similar) or small groups, feeding quietly on the ground and not associating with other seed-eating birds.

name: Buffy Tuftedcheek
rangeDescription: Highlands of costa rica and western panama (western chiriquí)
description: This striking cloud forest bird is only found in the highlands of Costa Rica and western Panama. It is easily recognized by its buffy throat and neck.

name: Kittlitz's Plover
rangeDescription: Sub-saharan africa, northeastern egypt, and madagascar
description: Small plover with a brown back and pale underparts. Distinctive head pattern, with one black stripe behind the eye and another across the forehead.

name: Sunda Minivet
rangeDescription: Highlands of sumatra and java
description: Brightly-colored and long-tailed inhabitant of foothill and montane forests in Java and Sumatra (1200-2700 meters). Social, often traveling in large flocks in the forest canopy.

name: Flammulated Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Pacific lowlands of western mexico (sinaloa to western chiapas)
description: Medium-sized flycatcher of thorn forest and brushy woodland in tropical lowlands and foothills of west Mexico. Mostly sluggish and easily overlooked unless singing; tends to stay within cover rather than coming out into open areas.

name: Gray-faced Buzzard
rangeDescription: Northeastern asia; winters southeastern asia to philippines and indonesia
description: Long-winged raptor, often seen in large kettles on migration. Breeds in montane forests, where its strident two-note whistle is often heard.

name: Krüper's Nuthatch
rangeDescription: Pine, cedar and juniper forest of türkiye to caucasus mountains
description: Small nuthatch with a bold white eyebrow, a dark crown (black in male), and prominent rusty breast patch and undertail coverts. Breeds in coniferous and mixed forests in middle elevations.

name: Narcondam Hornbill
rangeDescription: Lowland forest of narcondam (northern andaman islands)
description: A small hornbill with a black body, a white tail, and a strong pale bill with a flat, grooved casque on top. The male has a rust-colored head and breast, while the female’s head and breast are black.

name: Red-faced Barbet
rangeDescription: Acacia belt of southwestern uganda to eastern rwanda and northwestern tanzania
description: Chunky, medium-sized black barbet. There is red on the face, and the bottom part of the wing has white edging.

name: Somali Grosbeak
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern somalia near ethiopian border
description: Handsome chunky gray-brown finch with a massive dark bill, dark-brown cap, and blackish face mask extending to the throat. Female has a paler forehead and crown.

name: Sind Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Arid woodland and desert scrub of southeastern iran to pakistan
description: Only black-and-white woodpecker in most of its range. Note the big white shoulder patches and white bars on the black back.

name: African River Martin
rangeDescription: Large rivers of democratic republic of the congo; winters to coastal gabon
description: Enigmatic and distinctive, this compact all-dark martin has striking red eyes and a bright orange-red bill. Juvenile is duller.

name: Boyd's Shearwater
rangeDescription: Cape verde islands
description: Small to medium shearwater that breeds only on Cape Verde islands. Closely related to Sargasso and Barolo Shearwaters.

name: Rufous Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Alaska to northwestern usa; winters to southern mexico
description: Adult males are almost entirely orange with bright white chest and some green on the back (can be solid green like Allen's Hummingbird). Throat is iridescent, and depending on the light, can look anywhere from red to orange to yellow to lime green.

name: Gough Island Finch
rangeDescription: Gough (southern atlantic ocean)
description: A large striking finch with a dagger-like bill and different looking sexes. Male is mostly olive with a black throat and yellow eye-ring and moustache; female is brownish and lacks the black throat.
